source_refs.note: Pericardium: a main subheading of 11.1 Structure and functioning of the heart, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 234-235.

blocks.text: Dil ek thaili (sac) mein band hota hai jise pericardium kehte hain (Figure 11.1). Pericardium dil ko aas paas ke aza (organs) se alag rakhta hai. Is ki do tahein (layers) hain:

items: Bahar wali tah fibrous pericardium kehlati hai. Yeh mazboot connective tissue (jorne wala tissue) se bani hai. Yeh dil ko bahar ke dabao (pressure) aur jhatkon (shocks) se bachati hai, aur dil ko had se zyada phailne (excessive dilation) se rokti hai.

Andar wali tah serous pericardium kehlati hai. Yeh khud ek thaili hai jis ki do tahein hain: a) bahar wali parietal pericardium, jo fibrous pericardium ke neeche hai; b) andar wali visceral pericardium (isay epicardium bhi kehte hain), jo dil se bilkul chipki hui hai.

blocks.text: Parietal aur visceral pericardium ke beech ki khali jagah pericardial cavity kehlati hai. Is mein 50 mL tak pericardial fluid hota hai. Yeh fluid dil ko chikna (lubricate) rakhta hai taake ragar na ho, aur dil ko infections se bachata hai.
